keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword, e.g. Dynamics 365. Ignored if Start URLs is set.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Search result URLs pasted from your browser (with your filters applied).

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum jobs to return (30 jobs per search page).

includeDetails.title: Include job details
includeDetails.description: Open each job page for the full description, hours per week and date updated.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days
postedWithinDays.description: Only keep jobs posted in the last N days. 0 = off.

startDate.title: Posted from (start date)
startDate.description: Only keep jobs posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides "Posted within days".

endDate.title: Posted until (end date)
endDate.description: Only keep jobs posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: OnlineJobs.ph's robots.txt asks for 5 seconds. Lowering this is faster but less polite and may get you blocked.

redactContactInfo.title: Redact contact info
redactContactInfo.description: Replace emails, phone numbers, messenger IDs, @handles and personal profile links in job descriptions with [redacted].
